statlog.configuration.title: Statlog Settings
statlog.gui.title: Statlog
statlog.attribute.attack_speed.descripti: Increases attack speed and shortens enemy invulnerability after a hit.
statlog.attribute.knockback.description: Reduces how far you are knocked back.
statlog.attribute.attack_knockback.descr: Pushes enemies farther with melee hits.
statlog.attribute.burning_time.descripti: Shortens the time you stay on fire.
statlog.attribute.fall_reduction.descrip: Reduces fall damage and increases your safe fall distance.
statlog.attribute.step_height.descriptio: Lets you step over taller ledges.
statlog.attribute.swimming.description: Moves you through water more easily.
statlog.command.orb.spawn: Spawned a Statlog %2$s orb worth %1$s points
statlog.config.title: Menu Title
statlog.config.title.tooltip: Title shown above the player preview; translation keys are supported.
statlog.config.currency_mode.tooltip: XP_LEVELS spends vanilla levels (default); XP spends vanilla points.
statlog.config.linear_vanilla_xp.tooltip: Use a fixed XP cost for each vanilla Minecraft level, so total XP grows linearly. Off keeps Minecraft's usual curve.
statlog.config.vanilla_xp_per_level.tool: XP points needed for each vanilla level when linear_vanilla_xp is on.
statlog.config.xp_cost_base.tooltip: Base cost for one attribute level in the selected XP currency.
statlog.config.xp_cost_increment.tooltip: Additional cost for each level already above the attribute minimum.
statlog.config.xp_requirement_base.toolt: XP required to advance from the starting level.
Additional XP required for each later level.
statlog.config.manual_xp_requirements.to: Optional next-level costs as level:cost entries; unspecified levels use the linear formula.
statlog.config.points_per_level.tooltip: Points awarded in one custom currency for each independent level gained.
statlog.config.points_award_currency.too: Custom currency ID receiving points_per_level; blank disables automatic awards.
statlog.config.edit_access.tooltip: ALWAYS, COMMAND, SCRIPT, or POINTS. COMMAND opens edit mode only via the operator command.
statlog.config.enable_respeccing.tooltip: Allow players to reduce committed stat levels. Disabled by default.
Fraction of the original payment returned per removed level, from 0.0 to 1.0.
statlog.config.respec_refund.tooltip: Optional refund override: 50% for a percentage, or 2 for two currency units per level. Blank uses respec_refund_percentage.
statlog.config.respec_requires_permissio: Require a player-specific permission set by the API or command.
statlog.config.keep_progress_on_death.to: Copy saved progression, currencies, and purchase history on death.
statlog.config.hold_to_jump_higher.toolt: Hold the jump key to reach the height allowed by Jump Strength. Off by default.
statlog.config.minimum_jump_strength.too: Jump impulse used for a tap. 0.42 is the vanilla player jump; lower values allow shorter jumps. Holding can still reach the Jump Strength limit.
statlog.config.show_tab.tooltip: Show the Statlog tab on the survival inventory.
statlog.config.show_edit_tab.tooltip: Show the book/barrier edit tab. Closing the screen already cancels unfinalized changes.
statlog.config.hide_single_tab.tooltip: Hide attribute tabs when only one tab is configured.
statlog.config.show_xp_bar.tooltip: Show the vanilla-style XP bar and level on the left side of Statlog.
statlog.config.show_tooltips.tooltip: Show attribute descriptions when hovering entries.
statlog.config.show_row_currency.tooltip: Show the required currency beside each attribute name. Multi-currency selectors stay visible.
statlog.config.show_tooltip_currency.too: Show the required currency in attribute tooltips too.
statlog.config.show_tooltip_currency_by_: Show the required currency next to the attribute name in its tooltip.
statlog.config.hide_single_currency.tool: Hide row currency icons and the balance beneath the player when XP is the only currency.
statlog.config.max_currency_icon.tooltip: Use the alternate currency dot for maxed attributes.
statlog.config.max_currency_sepia.toolti: Tint maxed attribute currency dots sepia.
statlog.config.show_current_value.toolti: Show the current stat bonus in attribute tooltips.
statlog.config.show_increment_value.tool: Show the next level's increment on a separate tooltip line.
statlog.config.current_value_text.toolti: Tooltip text for current bonus; {1}, {2}, etc. name each attribute in the stat.
statlog.config.increment_value_text.tool: Tooltip text for the next level; {1}, {2}, etc. name each attribute in the stat.
statlog.config.current_value_separator.t: Join aligned current_text entries with this text; Break starts a new line.
statlog.config.increment_value_separator: Join aligned increment_text entries with this text; Break starts a new line.
statlog.config.experience_color.tooltip: RGB hex color for Statlog progression displays.
statlog.config.attribute_row_height.tool: Attribute row height in GUI pixels; 23 keeps icons and controls clear.
statlog.config.panel_width.tooltip: Whole Statlog window width in GUI pixels; clamped to the screen.
statlog.config.panel_height.tooltip: Whole Statlog window height in GUI pixels; clamped to the screen.
statlog.config.animate_upgrade_badge.too: Make the inventory upgrade badge bob up and down.
statlog.config.after_finalize.tooltip: What to do after a successful Finalize: CLOSE, EDIT, or VIEW.
statlog.config.add_point_sound.tooltip: Sound event played when adding a stat point. Blank disables it.
statlog.config.remove_point_sound.toolti: Sound event played when subtracting a stat point. Blank disables it.
statlog.config.finalize_sound_enabled.to: Play a sound when Finalize commits at least one added stat level.
statlog.config.finalize_sound.tooltip: Sound event played after Finalize commits added stat levels. Blank disables it.
statlog.config.maxed_bold.tooltip: Bold the stat name and number when it reaches its maximum level.
statlog.config.maxed_text_sepia.tooltip: Use sepia for maxed stat names and numbers. A maxed_color overrides this.
statlog.config.maxed_color.tooltip: Optional #RRGGBB override for a maxed stat name and number. Blank uses maxed_text_sepia.
statlog.config.tooltip_width_scale.toolt: Tooltip width relative to the attribute panel width.
statlog.config.tooltip_width_offset.tool: Extra tooltip width in GUI pixels after scaling.
statlog.config.tooltip_x_offset.tooltip: Horizontal GUI-pixel offset from the automatic tooltip placement.
statlog.config.tooltip_y_offset.tooltip: Vertical GUI-pixel offset from the automatic tooltip placement.
statlog.config.xp_bar_scale.tooltip: Uniform scale of the 182x5 vanilla XP bar, constrained by the player panel width.
statlog.config.xp_bar_x_offset.tooltip: Horizontal GUI-pixel offset from the centered XP bar.
statlog.config.xp_bar_y_offset.tooltip: Vertical GUI-pixel offset from the default XP bar position.
statlog.config.scroll_x_scale.tooltip: Scrollbar X position = stat list X + list width * x_scale + x_offset. This does not change its size.
statlog.config.scroll_x_offset.tooltip: Horizontal offset in GUI pixels; decimals allow half-pixel placement.
statlog.config.scroll_y_scale.tooltip: Scrollbar Y position = stat list Y + list height * y_scale + y_offset. This does not change its size.
